title: Middle of the road calendar
body:
The advantages of using the built in calendar are low battery usage, proper integration with the apple watch, working widgets and performance.

But has many drawbacks that are simple features available in other applications. For instance, a better assortment of widgets, color options for different events and a way to unsubscribe from other calendars. 

Mainly the syncing and notifications working perfectly in my apple watch is what brings me back to this app. But I do enjoy using fantastical way more, is a much better app in everything else.

title: Errors and compatibility
body:
There has been a lot of issues syncing calendars, this was a cool app, but Apple every day shows a careless software developing incrementing progressively, It is a shame, they have resources no company could ever dream, still, they are loosing their advantage mainly because of poor judgment in projects leading, combining different projections, loosing focus. I do care about my favorite platform being teared apart. 
They have stopped developing this app, no new functions and the ones it already have are not working as they should, it even gets confusing when traveling with the scheduling, it was so natural before, it seems like iOS and native apps are being tested by different groups with no communication between them.
